title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions on gymnastics gold, European qualifiers, league politics and judo diplomacy from this week's Israel Sports Pulse coverage.

questions.question: At which venue did Artem Dolgopyat win Israel's second Olympic gold medal, in the men's floor exercise on 1 August 2021?
questions.explanation: Dolgopyat won the floor exercise final at Tokyo's Ariake Gymnastics Centre, tying Spain's Rayderley Zapata on points but taking gold on a higher difficulty score under FIG tie-break rules.

questions.question: What was the first-leg score when Beitar Jerusalem beat AEK Larnaca in Larnaca on 23 July 2026?
questions.explanation: Colombian defender Brayan Carabalí scored the only goal with a 77th-minute direct free-kick after AEK's Mike van der Hoorn was sent off.

questions.question: Who chairs the Israeli Basketball Super League management board and warned that "a team unworthy of the league won't be here"?
questions.explanation: Steinberg, the league management board chairman, said on ONE's "Today's Conversation" that clubs failing to meet arena standards would not be allowed to compete in the top flight.

questions.question: At the 2019 World Judo Championships in Tokyo, which Iranian judoka was ordered by Iranian authorities to withdraw rather than risk facing Sagi Muki?
questions.explanation: Mollaei, then the defending champion, was ordered to withdraw to avoid a possible semi-final against Muki, who went on to win gold; Mollaei later fled Iran and won Olympic silver for Mongolia.

questions.question: According to ONE, which two Italian clubs have scouted Maccabi Tel Aviv forward Sayed Abu Farchi after his brace in the 5-0 win over Sheriff Tiraspol?
questions.explanation: ONE reported that Genoa and Torino have scouted Abu Farchi, though work-permit issues could complicate any transfer.
